description: This PHP class file defines an interface for integrating with a GForge issue tracker via SOAP API. It includes methods for connecting to the tracker, retrieving issue details, checking issue existence, and formatting issue status and summaries. The class extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and manages API client interactions, issue status codes, and configuration setup.

classes.name: gforgesoapInterface
classes.description: Class providing SOAP API integration with GForge issue tracker, including connection, issue retrieval, status handling, and configuration management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration, completing setup, and establishing connection to GForge via SOAP.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Sets default WSDL, view, and create URLs based on base URI if not provided.

methods.name: getAuthToken
methods.description: Returns the current authentication token used for API calls.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Fetches the status code (integer) for a specific issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status string for a given issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueSummary
methods.description: Fetches and returns the summary/title of an issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed issue information from the tracker, including extra fields, with debugging outputs.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a bug/issue ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue ID exists in the tracker.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a SOAP connection to the GForge server and logs in to obtain an auth token.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to the tracker is active.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SOAP client, handling faults and logging.

methods.name: helperParseDate
methods.description: Parses date strings into formatted due date strings.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides an XML template for configuring the GForge tracker integration.

methods.name: getStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns the array defining the domain of status codes.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Builds an HTML-formatted string representing the issue status, crossing out 'closed' or 'resolved' statuses.

methods.name: buildSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Constructs an HTML summary string for the issue, including due date information.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks if the environment has the SOAP extension enabled.
